name: Atlas dogfood — a fresh agent orients via atlas, then verifies
description: Adoption proof for packages/atlas: a cheap model orients in the monorepo using ONLY the atlas CLI first, answers a real question, then verifies atlas's answer against the actual files. Measures whether the map actually shortens orientation. Params: question (what to answer), scope (atlas scope to show), cwd (monorepo root), agent (who to notify with the result).

params.prompt:
You are a brand-new agent in this monorepo and you know NOTHING about its layout.

{{params.orient}}

Then answer this question:

=== QUESTION ===
{{params.question}}

VERIFY your answer by reading the actual file(s) before committing to it.

Reply in exactly this shape:
A) ORIENTATION: <how you found your way — tools/commands used, in order>
B) ANSWER: <the answer to the question, with file path(s)>
C) VERIFIED: <did the actual files confirm? yes/no + any surprise>
D) FILES OPENED: <count and list — the orientation cost>

meta.description: Orient — Haiku, cold agent, atlas-first, then verify against ground truth.
